import hashlib,json,sys,types
raw=sys.stdin.buffer.read(524289)
assert 0<len(raw)<=524288 and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='43d578eb31181c002f4167dea94310a71cf73963feac77db1546d2c8c1818975'
p=json.loads(raw)
assert set(p)=={'schema','control_source','control_sha256','payload'} and p['schema']==1
source=p['control_source'].encode('utf-8')
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==p['control_sha256']=='04d9787b8d98e9c5b3317879a9a6e57256619d78f7c86b28f13fcd1c0d726945'
module=types.ModuleType('pure_bili_r9_player02_component_controls');module.__file__='<check_current_flow.py>'
exec(compile(source,module.__file__,'exec'),module.__dict__)
result=module.run_controls(p['payload'])
assert result['all_passed'] is True and result['count']==21 and len(result['cases'])==21 and all(x['passed'] is True for x in result['cases'])
manifest=(json.dumps({'files':p['payload']['pins']['new'],'schema':1},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode('utf-8')
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest()=='296da6728d720584339eb47e47801e0c458c3427d06e3a593acdc2f0bc3c6e5d'
result['new_source_manifest_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest()
result['control_source_sha256']=p['control_sha256']
result['packet_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
result['actual_install_binding']=p['payload']['binding_proof']
encoded=json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
assert len(encoded.encode())<=32768
print(encoded,flush=True)
